title: Presheaf scalar restriction has a left adjoint in larger universes
statement: Let k be a ring, X a topological space and R a sheaf of rings on X, all in universe u, with alpha:k -> R(X). For every universe v, the presheaf pushforward along the identity site and the structural map [def-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-ring-map], from R-module presheaves with carriers in Type(max u v) to modules over the constant k-presheaf, is a right adjoint. No commutativity or field hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

proof.text: For the structural map [def-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-ring-map], regard R(U) as a right k-module via r*c=r*alpha_U(c), commuting with its left R(U)-action. For any constant-k module presheaf V construct at U the balanced tensor R(U) tensor_k V(U), and give it the left R(U)-action on the first factor. This works for arbitrary rings k and noncommutative rings R(U).

proof.text: Restrictions send r tensor m to res(r) tensor res(m). They respect the balanced relations since alpha is natural; identity and composition follow on pure tensors. On morphisms tensor each component with the identity. A natural k-linear map V -> restriction(M) extends by r tensor m -> r times its image. Conversely an R-linear map out of the tensor presheaf restricts along m -> 1 tensor m. The two constructions are inverse and natural, giving a left adjoint. Tensor products can be constructed as quotients of free abelian groups on pairs, so the carriers remain in Type(max u v). The usual Mathlib choice of a left adjoint is uniquely naturally isomorphic to this tensor construction.

lean.statement:
theorem fieldScalarPresheafPullback_isRightAdjoint
    {k : Type u} [Ring k] (X : TopCat.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (α : k →+* R.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward.{max u v}
      (fieldScalarPresheafRingMap X R α)).IsRightAdjoint
